lesson: The system is consistently attempting to front-run trend reversals against strong momentum, resulting in three consecutive stop-outs as price ignores oversold RSI and liquidity sweeps. The reliance on lower-timeframe divergence is failing because the broader market structure remains decisively bearish, causing the system to catch falling knives.
adjustment: Implement a 'Trend Filter' rule: strictly prohibit long entries unless the 4H price closes above the 50 EMA, regardless of divergence or liquidity sweep signals.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI-based mean reversion less on XRPUSDT until the 4H trend aligns with the trade direction.
